title: Japanese Cheonggukjang Risotto Bowl
description: A hearty Japanese-inspired risotto dish using Korean cheonggukjang paste, served in a bowl. Rich and silky texture makes this a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add grated ginger and sauté for 1 minute.
Add Japanese short-grain rice and stir to coat in oil and mix with ginger.
Add vegetable broth, 1 cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each cup to absorb before adding the next.
After 20 minutes of cooking, stir in Cheonggukjang paste and miso paste. Continue to cook for another 2 minutes.
Season with soy sauce to taste.
Transfer the risotto to a large bowl. Garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.
